defmodule FileService.Router do
  use Plug.Router
  require Logger

  plug :match
  plug :dispatch

  @upload_root "/var/data/uploads"
  @temp_root "/var/data/temp"

  defmodule Auth do
    def verify_token(token) do
      case Phoenix.Token.verify(FileService.Endpoint, "user_auth", token, max_age: 86400) do
        {:ok, user_id} -> {:ok, user_id}
        {:error, _} -> :error
      end
    end

    def get_role(user_id) do
      case FileService.Repo.get(FileService.User, user_id) do
        nil -> :guest
        %{role: role} -> String.to_existing_atom(role)
      end
    end

    def authorize(role, action) do
      permissions = %{
        admin: [:read, :write, :delete, :export],
        editor: [:read, :write, :export],
        viewer: [:read],
        guest: []
      }

      action in Map.get(permissions, role, [])
    end
  end

  defmodule PathValidator do
    @doc "Validates that the resolved path stays within the allowed directory."
    def safe_path?(base_dir, requested_path) do
      full_path = Path.join(base_dir, requested_path)
      normalized = Path.expand(full_path)
      String.starts_with?(normalized, Path.expand(base_dir))
    end

    @doc "Resolves the canonical path, following symlinks for validation."
    def resolve_canonical(path) do
      case System.cmd("readlink", ["-f", path], stderr_to_stdout: true) do
        {resolved, 0} -> {:ok, String.trim(resolved)}
        _ -> {:error, :resolution_failed}
      end
    end
  end

  defmodule ExportService do
    @export_staging "/var/data/temp/exports"

    def prepare_export(user_id, file_path, base_dir) do
      staging_dir = Path.join(@export_staging, "#{user_id}_#{:os.system_time(:millisecond)}")
      File.mkdir_p!(staging_dir)

      source = Path.join(base_dir, file_path)
      dest = Path.join(staging_dir, Path.basename(file_path))

      # Stage the file by creating a symlink to avoid copying large files
      File.ln_s!(source, dest)

      {:ok, staging_dir, dest}
    end

    def finalize_export(staging_dir, dest_path, user_id) do
      # Validate the staged file before packaging
      archive_name = "export_#{user_id}_#{:os.system_time(:millisecond)}.tar.gz"
      archive_path = Path.join(staging_dir, archive_name)

      # Read through the symlink - this follows the link at read time
      case File.read(dest_path) do
        {:ok, content} ->
          # Package into archive
          :erl_tar.create(String.to_charlist(archive_path),
            [{String.to_charlist(Path.basename(dest_path)), content}],
            [:compressed])
          {:ok, archive_path}
        {:error, reason} ->
          {:error, reason}
      end
    end
  end

  post "/api/export" do
    with {:ok, body, conn} <- Plug.Conn.read_body(conn),
         {:ok, params} <- Jason.decode(body),
         token <- get_req_header(conn, "authorization") |> List.first(),
         {:ok, user_id} <- Auth.verify_token(token),
         role <- Auth.get_role(user_id),
         true <- Auth.authorize(role, :export) do

      file_path = Map.get(params, "path", "")

      # Step 1: Validate the path is within bounds BEFORE staging
      unless PathValidator.safe_path?(@upload_root, file_path) do
        send_resp(conn, 403, Jason.encode!(%{error: "Path not allowed"}))
      end

      # Step 2: Prepare export (creates symlink in staging)
      {:ok, staging_dir, staged_file} = ExportService.prepare_export(
        user_id, file_path, @upload_root
      )

      # Step 3: Validate the canonical path of the staged symlink
      # This checks where the symlink CURRENTLY points
      case PathValidator.resolve_canonical(staged_file) do
        {:ok, canonical} ->
          if String.starts_with?(canonical, Path.expand(@upload_root)) do
            # Step 4: Finalize - but there's a TOCTOU window here
            # Between resolve_canonical and finalize_export, the original
            # file at source could be replaced with a symlink to /etc/shadow
            case ExportService.finalize_export(staging_dir, staged_file, user_id) do
              {:ok, archive_path} ->
                send_file(conn, 200, archive_path)
              {:error, _} ->
                send_resp(conn, 500, Jason.encode!(%{error: "Export failed"}))
            end
          else
            File.rm_rf!(staging_dir)
            send_resp(conn, 403, Jason.encode!(%{error: "Symlink target not allowed"}))
          end
        {:error, _} ->
          File.rm_rf!(staging_dir)
          send_resp(conn, 500, Jason.encode!(%{error: "Path resolution failed"}))
      end
    else
      _ -> send_resp(conn, 401, Jason.encode!(%{error: "Unauthorized"}))
    end
  end

  get "/api/files/:path" do
    with token <- get_req_header(conn, "authorization") |> List.first(),
         {:ok, user_id} <- Auth.verify_token(token),
         role <- Auth.get_role(user_id),
         true <- Auth.authorize(role, :read) do

      requested = URI.decode(path)

      if PathValidator.safe_path?(@upload_root, requested) do
        full = Path.join(@upload_root, requested) |> Path.expand()
        send_file(conn, 200, full)
      else
        send_resp(conn, 403, Jason.encode!(%{error: "Access denied"}))
      end
    else
      _ -> send_resp(conn, 401, Jason.encode!(%{error: "Unauthorized"}))
    end
  end

  match _ do
    send_resp(conn, 404, "Not found")
  end
end
